sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def state(f):
    trk=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=17 and min(cs)>=35:
                trk.append((n['color'],min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs)))
    bar=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='N' and min(cs)>=60:
            bar=(min([p[0] for p in b]),max([p[0] for p in b]))
    W=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']<20:
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cs)<60: W+=1
    return (sorted(trk),bar,W)

print("before:", state(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    action([{'action':'RIGHT'}])
    r=last_action_result
    print(f"after {i+1}:", state(current_frame), "done=",r.get('done'),"lc=",r.get('level_completed'),"go=",r.get('game_over'))
    if r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('game_over'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def state(f):
    trk=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)>=17 and min(cs)>=35:
                trk.append((n['color'],min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs)))
    bar=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='N' and min(cs)>=60:
            bar=(min([p[0] for p in b]),max([p[0] for p in b]))
    W=0
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']<20:
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(cs)<60: W+=1
    return (sorted(trk),bar,W)
